title: InterpreterSettings
description: Mirrors the subset of hayro_interpret::InterpreterSettings this bridge exposes. font_resolver/cmap_resolver/warning_sink are Rust closures with no plain-data representation and aren't part of this shape - see the crate README's "zero required host imports" goal. This is documentation, kept in sync by hand with the InterpreterSettingsJson struct in src/lib.rs, not something validated against at runtime.

render_annotations.description: Absent means "use hayro's default" (read from InterpreterSettings::default() at call time, not hardcoded here).
